==Descriptions==
'''Winterfall''' was the original [[map]] made for the [[Frost Invasion Event]], which would later be replaced by [[Frozen Battlefront]]. However, neither map ended up in the game as [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] became the event's map.

Like other event maps, it would have had a specialized wave structure with special [[enemies]], which from teasers posted before the update would have mostly been the same as enemies seen in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]], though some of them like [[Snowy (Frost Invasion)|Snowy]] did receive minor appearance changes.

==Design & Path==
'''Winterfall''' is a location surrounded by cliffs on most sides and water on one side. A small river runs through the terrain that cuts the map in half. A bridge is built on top of that river, connecting the split portions of the map. Multiple buildings, including large houses, towers and a castle can be seen on the map. Various trees, lanterns and icicles are scattered around the map.

The path starts at a cave and ends at the castle. It takes multiple turns, avoiding the river, buildings and cliffs put on the map.

==Trivia==
*Despite never releasing, various teasers and promotional images would actually use multiple versions of the map rather than [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]].
*'''Winterfall''' shares some similarities to [[Winter Stronghold]], [[Winter Abyss]] and [[Trick or Threat Town]].
